title: Clinical outcomes of two symmetrical Kera-rings implanted in grade three keratoconus: a retrospective nonrandomized study

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License; ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/)

groups.description: One eye of each of 23 patients with Amsler-Krumeich grade 3 keratoconus and a central cone; two symmetrical 160-degree Keraring SI-5 segments (250 or 300 um) implanted in femtosecond-laser tunnels; inclusion required stable keratoconus and corneal cross-linking performed at least 6 months before presentation (no cross-linking during the tabulated follow-up); retrospective; mean age 22.8 +/- 6.84 years, age range not reported

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 3 footnote); unit D in the row label; Pentacam (Oculus) sagittal map per Methods; columns 'After 3 m', 'After 6 m', 'After 9 m', 'After 12 m'; per-visit n not reported (23 eyes)

exclusions.what: Table 3 P value row under K max (Tab3!R3)
evaluations on days 1, 7 and 14 and at 1 month
exclusions.reason: Kmax not tabulated at these visits

notes: Procedure context icrs: the tabulated follow-up starts at ring-segment implantation; all eyes had corneal cross-linking at least 6 months before presentation (an inclusion criterion), so cross-linking precedes the baseline and is not part of the tabulated treatment.
Age group unstated: only mean age 22.8 +/- 6.84 years is reported, without a range or an age criterion.

Table 3 also gives K mean, K1, K2, anterior and posterior elevation, topographic cylinder and anterior and posterior Q values; Table 2 gives refraction, UCVA, BCVA and thinnest pachymetry; Table 4 gives Belin ABCD grades (not extracted).
